purpose: Versioned comparison requirements for the ZenAssetProcessor extraction and cooking profiles

reference_profile.status: initial parity contract based on existing SceneAssetIO exact round-trip tests
required_semantics: nodes, roots, hierarchy, affine transforms, visibility and instancing
mesh topology, primitive material references, vertex/index streams and bounds
all UV/color/influence/morph/custom-attribute streams and their domains
materials, samplers, color spaces, texture transforms and variants
decoded pixels, authored mip chains and HDR environment data
skins, inverse-bind matrices, clips, typed targets and interpolation
cameras, punctual lights, physical units and diagnostics
reference_profile.render_comparison_note: Use identical renderer, camera, exposure, lights, environment, fixed animation time and deterministic accumulation. Investigate nondeterminism before changing an exact threshold.

existing_fbx_bake_settings.note: Preserve these existing importer settings. They do not license new cooking loss in the reference profile.

desktop_profile.status: provisional thresholds; must be evaluated against M4/M5 corpus evidence before enabling lossy passes by default
desktop_profile.semantic_rules: All reference semantic checks remain required except explicitly enabled lossy payloads and declared remapping. Compare values after resolving mappings.

quantization.note: A pose or morph-specific bound failure rejects that optimization. These settings do not enable simplification or LOD generation.

texture_encoding.normal_filtering_note: Filter stored channels before normal reconstruction using authored wrap behavior. Production qualification bounds continuous bilinear UV within each image level and the complete shared UV-phase/adjacent-mip blend domain jointly. Each domain must satisfy the unchanged RMS and maximum angle limits. The declared fixed grids remain independent audit samples, not proof of continuity. Anisotropic filtering, device precision and rendered quality remain separate requirements.

normal_joint_qualification.domain: continuous shared U/V phases and adjacent-mip blend fractions; same normalized coordinates at both levels
normal_joint_qualification.linear_minification: partition each fine texel cell at coarse tap boundaries; trilinear tensor Bernstein bounds
normal_joint_qualification.nearest_minification: correlated fine/coarse tap states including exact cuts/endpoints; affine LOD bounds
normal_joint_qualification.bc5_bound: corner-chord angular bound plus positive-Z range and Hessian interpolation bounds
normal_joint_qualification.aggregation: RMS of one per-cell angular upper bound over every joint box, with a separate maximum-angle bound
normal_joint_qualification.uncertified_action: retain the complete original image and every authored mip
normal_joint_qualification.diagnostics: common-phase observed errors, certified leaf upper bounds and the complete-domain flag are distinct

normal_uv_qualification.domain: continuous bilinear UV phase rectangles within individual mip levels
normal_uv_qualification.bc7_bound: tensor Bernstein bounds on bilinear direction cross and dot products
normal_uv_qualification.bc5_bound: bilinear corner-chord angular bound plus positive-Z range and Hessian interpolation bounds
normal_uv_qualification.aggregation: RMS of per-texel angular upper bounds over every phase rectangle, with a separate maximum-angle bound
normal_uv_qualification.uncertified_action: retain the complete original image and every authored mip
normal_uv_qualification.diagnostics: original quarter-phase metrics, adaptive observations and certified leaf bounds are distinct

texture_encoding.note: Measure each image and each mip separately in the correct color space, with HDR range and alpha-test cutoff recorded; corpus averages cannot hide failures. Unsuitable images retain uncompressed storage.

required_measurements.note: Keep preliminary samples separate from the fresh M0 three cold/fifteen warm measurements recorded in Doc/ZenAssetProcessorM0Verification.md. Missing per-resource GPU allocations and GPU upload execution metrics remain unverified.
